Callout.Name: Fall Down Stairs
Callout.Message: Person fallen down a flight of stairs at home.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, hip and wrist pain, family at home.
Callout.Patient: I missed the last step. It hurt more than I expected.

Lines.Approach: Down the whole flight, and she is more worried about the mess than her wrist.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
